import numpy as np
A=np.array(grid)
# list largest all-same rectangles dimensions >=4 each via exhaustive row strips and runs
rects=[]
for r0 in range(30):
 for r1 in range(r0+4,30):
  # columns where all rows same value
  vals=A[r0]
  valid=np.all(A[r0:r1+1]==vals,axis=0)
  c=0
  while c<30:
   if valid[c]:
    d=c
    while d+1<30 and valid[d+1] and vals[d+1]==vals[c]: d+=1
    if d-c+1>=4: rects.append((r1-r0+1,d-c+1,int(vals[c]),r0,c,r1,d))
    c=d+1
   else:c+=1
sorted(rects, reverse=True)[:40]
